scenarios.observes: Read every row-major element of asymmetric 2×3 and 3×2 inputs backed by the same six values.

findings.summary: SpiceyPy 6.0.3 swaps nr and nc in its MEQUG call. Their product preserves ordinary copy length, hiding the ordering issue. Its nested NumPy signature also does not retain the full exposed rectangular empty-shape domain.
findings.repair: Call the reviewed independent mequg_c ABI in C argument order with owned non-null storage. Separately compare a positive nonsquare call with the ordinary wrapper byte for byte, including negative zero.
